# Copilot instructions for this repository

Purpose: guide Copilot for this Nix flake config.

---
1) Build, test, run

- Build flake root:
  - nix build

- Build host toplevel (replace <host>):
  - nix build ".#nixosConfigurations.<host>.config.system.build.toplevel"

- Rebuild remote host:
  - ./scripts/rebuild.sh <ssh-target>

- Deploy / generate hardware:
  - ./scripts/deploy.sh <ssh-target> <host-attribute-name>
  - ./scripts/local.sh <host-attribute-name>

- One-offs used by scripts:
  - nix run github:nix-community/nixos-anywhere -- --flake ".#<host>" --extra-files ./extra-files
  - nix run github:nix-community/disko/latest#disko-install -- --flake ".#<host>"

- Tests/lint: none present

---
2) High-level architecture

- Nix flake composes modular NixOS/darwin/home-manager configs.
- flake.nix uses flake-parts + import-tree to load modules/.
- modules/flake wires outputs; modules/nixos contains reusable modules; modules/hosts lists host attrs.
- Hosts hardware: hosts/<name>/hardware.nix (generated by scripts, committed).
- extra-files/ passed to installer flows.

---
3) Key conventions

- Hosts: modules/hosts/<name> as attribute set. Fields: arch, stateVersion, modules (deferred).
- Hardware: hosts/<name>/hardware.nix is committed; scripts assume git-add.
- Modules: add reusable features under modules/nixos/*. Expose options under options.nubabe.*.
- Validation: prefer building explicit host toplevel for quick check.
  - nix build ".#nixosConfigurations.<host>.config.system.build.toplevel"

---
4) AI-assistant files checked

- No CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CONVENTIONS.md, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, nor other assistant configs found.
